DecisionChange.description:
A change to the owner's decisions on a clip. A field set to null resets it; a field
left out is unchanged (ADR 0042).
DecisionChange.title: DecisionChange

FolderRef.description:
Desktop: ``path`` (absolute). Server: ``root`` (a media root id) and ``path``
inside it.
FolderRef.title: FolderRef

LockShot.description:
Lock (or unlock) a shot: a hard constraint on every later change (invariant 10).
The server fills ``pin`` (the shot's cut as the draft times it now) and ``absorb``
(picks cut together with it) when it records the op (ADR 0068).
LockShot.title: LockShot

MoveShot.description: Move a shot to ``index`` in ``beat_id`` (its own beat or another).
MoveShot.title: MoveShot

PaceBeat.description:
Make a beat faster (shorter shots) or slower (longer ones): every free shot's
length moves one step; locked shots keep their cut.
PaceBeat.title: PaceBeat

Pin.description:
A locked shot's exact cut (ADR 0068): which segment, its source range in the
source's time base and its length at the timeline rate (invariant 3).
Pin.title: Pin

RelinkBody.description:
Desktop: ``choose_folder`` (absolute). Server: ``root`` and ``path`` inside it, the
way the folder browser names folders (ADR 0035).
RelinkBody.title: RelinkBody

RenderBody.description:
M0 subset of ``POST /renders``. ``final`` stands in for S19's preset/resolution
(1080p SDR final from originals, or a 720p preview from proxies).
RenderBody.title: RenderBody

ReplaceShot.description: Replace a shot's segment with one of its alternatives or its beat's pool.
ReplaceShot.title: ReplaceShot

ResumeBody.description: Optional on resume: a higher AI cost limit (a cost-limit pause needs one).
ResumeBody.title: ResumeBody

SetDuration.description:
A new length for the edit ("Make it 90 seconds"): the storyboard is re-timed to it
with no AI call (PRODUCT.md §8; ADR 0071).
SetDuration.title: SetDuration

SetWeight.description:
More or less of a content category (PRODUCT.md §8; ADR 0074): the request's weight
for it, from the next timing or regeneration on.
SetWeight.title: SetWeight
